title: Kissed Roasted Slovakian Oats Bowl
description: Hearty roasted oats bowl from Slovakia, suitable for meal prep, with a touch of sesame and sunflower seeds.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oats, sesame seeds, sunflower seeds, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together water and olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the wet ingredients and mix well.
Pour the wet ingredients over the oat mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 10x10 inch baking dish and roast for 25 minutes.
While the oats are roasting, dry the dried mushrooms on a paper towel to remove excess moisture.
After 25 minutes, remove the oats from the oven and stir in the dried mushrooms.
Return the oats to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the oats from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Spoon the oats into individual mason jars and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional sesame seeds and sunflower seeds if desired.
